title: Driver Incentive Terms, Schedule Q1: Peak-Driver Supplement on Quest Rewards
content:
A quest reward credited under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** includes a peak-driver supplement, which follows how many trips earned peak-trip Pro points for the earnings account in the current quarter: 20 or more add 12.00; at least 5 but fewer than 20 add 6.00; fewer than 5 add nothing.

The supplement is a USD amount added to the stated reward amount after any multiplication of that stated amount; it is not itself multiplied, and the sum is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Schedule Q1

| Trips that earned peak-trip Pro points this quarter | Peak-driver supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 4 | 0.00 |
| 5 to 19 | 6.00 |
| 20 or more | 12.00 |

The count is of trips whose Pro points were earned on the peak-trip basis for the current quarter; trips that earned premium-trip or standard-trip points, and peak trips of an earlier quarter, are not counted.

## Edges (hypothetical counts)

| Peak-point trips this quarter | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 4 | 0.00 |
| 5 | 6.00 |
| 19 | 6.00 |
| 20 | 12.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A stated reward of 80.00 that becomes 84.00 after its multiplication, for an account with 23 peak-point trips this quarter, comes to 96.00 with the supplement (84.00 and 12.00 added together).
